request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Constellation Crab".

Creative brief
Name: Constellation Crab
Collection: Arcane Menagerie. Wild creatures altered by concentrated magic, with crystalline anatomy, runes, echoes, orbiting objects, and unusual projectile behavior.
Core concept: A tactical caster that connects star projectiles into temporary danger lines.
Body and silhouette: Wide crab with long angular legs, a flat night-sky shell, and two raised crystal claws.
Signature features: Star points on the shell, glowing connecting lines, and crescent-shaped eyes.
Palette and materials: Midnight blue, pale gold, muted purple, and silver-white light.
Movement personality: Sideways, deliberate, and diagram-like.
Attack concept: Places three bright star orbs around itself, pauses, and then sends damaging beams briefly along the triangle between them.
Directional details: A crescent marking occupies only the shell’s upper-right corner.
Avoid: Realistic ocean crab, zodiac text, beams appearing without placed stars.
